shared_elements: schematic incised/linear motifs on a surface
curved crescent-like form (torso band / boat hull)
small quadruped-like or animal-like sign (B) vs ambiguous marks (A)
repeated short parallel strokes forming a row
justification: Both surfaces bear reductive linear/schematic signs, and each contains a broad crescent-shaped arc with a row of short repeated strokes along it (A's belt-like band beneath a disc; B's crew-strokes along a boat hull), which is the only notable correspondence. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A depicts a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with face, hair, arms and a prominent ring/disc on the chest, while B depicts a manned boat with upcurved animal-headed prows accompanied by a small quadruped and detached limb-like signs.
